name: Wax Myrtle

facts.where: Wet East Texas woods and coast

caution: Use the leaves like bay: to flavor a pot, then removed before eating, not chewed. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: An evergreen shrub whose crushed leaves smell resinous and clean; the pale berries are coated in fragrant wax once used for candles.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: A leaf or two flavors soups and stews just like a bay leaf. Fish it out before serving.
